meta.title: Upcoming line items are visible but not actionable
gaps: Distinguish the specific upcoming line-item row from other line items and prove that its own row-level bid action is disabled
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Distinguish the specific upcoming line-item row from other line items and prove that its own row-level bid action is disabled

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live auction event with bidding activity.
Move to the vendor-facing session, which is the subject of this case.
Open the auction pricing view where upcoming line items and vendor bid controls are shown.
Assert that upcoming line-item state is visible to the vendor.
Assert that the vendor has no enabled bid submission action.
